guidelines: Each transcript is one turn of a session in datasets/sessions/synthetic.json: the conversation up to and including that answer, the evidence examined so far, and the hand-written interview state. Every sample starts from a fresh store, so the K samples of a transcript send identical requests.

expected is the human judgement of the answer against the pinned code: strong (accurate and specific), weak (contradicts the code or is unsupported), mixed (partly right or openly unsure). It feeds only the strong-above-weak sanity check, never the variability metrics.
Labels were set from the session descriptions and the planted flaws in the fixture repo, before any evaluation output was seen.
